how: One source mutation applied to the working tree, one jest suite run, then `git checkout -- <file>` before the next row. Driver: a per-task script (not committed) that reads the table below. `redTests` are the names that went red, the one the row is about first. Run on maintainer-mac-2, 2026-10-31.
note: Rows were re-issued by later drivers whenever their `before` text stopped matching the source or their test turned out too weak to see the guard — a NO-MATCH or a GREEN is not a proof, so this file holds only rows that actually went red against the code they name. Driver 3 covers the JSON5 lock reader and the baseline refusal's version message; drivers 5 and 6 cover X14 fix round 1 (the merge's write path, the provenance fields, the atomic write, the missing device), including four rows re-anchored because the review found their text no longer matched or matched twice.
